top_signals.title: Economists See RBA Rate Hike as Early as September After Hot CPI
top_signals.summary: Australia’s hot inflation spurred economists from Goldman Sachs Group Inc. to Commonwealth Bank to predict another interest-rate increase as early as next month, abandoning expectations of no change for the remainder of the year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Global Oil Security Looks Shakier as Conflicts Hit 45 Million Bpd of Supply
top_signals.summary: Almost half of the world’s oil supply is produced in regions currently engaged in hot conflicts, Reuters reported this week. The situation raises questions about long-term oil supply security and the limits to diversification. The Middle East, of course, is the most obvious and most disruptive example. While oil prices on speculative markets have remained capped by trader optimism, the physical supply of the vital energy commodity has been severely compromised, leading to rationing and emergency releases from storage across the world. Meanwhile,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gold Consolidates Above $4,600 as Investors Weigh Fed Rate Path
top_signals.summary: Gold consolidated above $4,600 an ounce as investors weighed the Federal Reserve’s approach to stubborn inflation ahead of the annual Jackson Hole gathering this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Thai Yield Gap May Narrow as Tame Inflation Boosts Long Bonds
top_signals.summary: Thailand’s yield curve may flatten as easing inflation and a slowing economy draw investor demand for longer-dated bonds, according to analysts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Li Ka-shing Keeps $23 Billion Ask for Ports Despite Panama Loss
top_signals.summary: Li Ka-shing’s CK Hutchison Holdings Ltd. expects to sell what remains of its global ports portfolio for its original $22.8 billion value, even after losing two Panama terminals that had been included, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Chainalysis estimates $457B in taxable crypto activity, says CARF misses most
top_signals.summary: The blockchain analytics firm said just 14% of the onchain activity it identified is covered by the OECD’s international crypto tax-reporting framework.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
